    • getComposition

      public FunctionsChapter3Style getComposition(Set<OrderedPair> op, Set<String> opCoDomain)
      precondition: getRelation() and op (the parameter) are both functions. Domain of op is a subset of coDomain of getRelation()
      Returns:
      a new FunctionsChapter3Style Object. The domain of new FunctionsChapter3Style Object is this.domain The coDomain is opCoDomain (the paramenter) The new function is the composition op( this.getRelation (this.domain) )
